answer: Give every agent a stake bonded to a verifiable work history, like a wharf that only lets ships dock after they have carried real cargo: an identity starts as a bare island, and it earns a crystal-clear reputation only by completing attested tasks over weeks. A sybil attacker must then pay weeks of compute and honest work per fake identity before it can vote or earn, so spawning a thousand clones costs a thousand times the effort, while genuine agents keep their earned standing.
